components.name: Hardware Button
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 2px; font: 700 12px 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; cursor: pointer; color: #f0f0ed; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #333 0%, #222 100%); border: 1px solid #0a0a0a; border-top-color: #444; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.4), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.1); transition: all 0.1s; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(2px); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.4), inset 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); border-top-color: #0a0a0a; } .ds-btn-primary { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ff6a00 0%, #ff4a00 100%); border-color: #992c00; border-top-color: #ff8b5a; text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.4); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ff7a22 0%, #ff6a00 100%); }

components.name: Physical LED (Up)
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 1px; color: #a0a0a0; } .ds-chip::before { content: ''; display: inline-block; width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; background: #222; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.8), 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.1); } .ds-chip-up::before { background: #00ff33; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 4px rgba(255,255,255,0.5), inset 0 -2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.4), 0 0 12px #00ff33; }

narrative.overview: A highly tactile, analog hardware UI inspired by premium audio equipment (e.g., synthesizers, mixing consoles). Instead of modern flat 'AI' aesthetics, this theme leans into physical affordances: deep matte black anodized aluminum, embossed chunky buttons, inset LCD screens, and intense physical LED lights.
dos: Do use strict top-down lighting (lighter top borders, dark bottom borders) to maintain physical realism.
Do use inset shadows for inputs and tables to make them feel like recessed screens.
donts: Don't use soft, blurry dropshadows or glassmorphism. This is solid matter, not translucent glass.
